# Awards and Recognition Hub

> Verified award dates, fair ways to recognise people and teams, and tools to send recognition where people work. Formerly the Recognition Opportunities Portal. Not an official GOV.UK service; organisers own their dates and rules.

Release v2026.11.24.19, sources verified 2026-11-22. Content OGL v3.0, code MIT. No AI model runs on the page; the Ask feature searches the page and can hand a prompt to your own assistant.

## Data

- [Portal data (JSON, the single source of truth)](https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/awards-and-recognition-hub/portal-data.json)
- [Source code, issues and roadmap](https://github.com/cyberdudeuk/awards-and-recognition-hub)

## Upcoming deadlines and ceremonies

- 2026-12-01 deadline: King's Award for Voluntary Service 2027 nominations close (source: https://kavs.dcms.gov.uk/make-a-nomination/)
- 2026-12-09 ceremony: Scottish Public Service Awards 2026 ceremony (source: https://events.holyrood.com/event/scottish-public-service-awards-2026/)
- 2026-12-10 deadline: Civil Service AI & Data Challenge 2026 to 2027 applications close (source: https://datachallenge.uk/)
- 2027-01-15 deadline: iESE Public Sector Transformation Awards 2027 nominations close (5pm) (source: https://iese.org.uk/awards/)
- 2027-03-01 ceremony (tentative): Civil Service Awards ceremony month begins (source: https://www.civilserviceawards.com/faqs/)
- 2027-03-03 ceremony: iESE Public Sector Transformation Awards 2027 ceremony (source: https://iese.org.uk/awards/)
- 2027-03-17 ceremony: British Diversity Awards 2027 winners / ceremony (source: https://www.britishdiversityawards.com/)
- 2027-03-24 ceremony: LGC Awards 2027 ceremony (source: https://awards.lgcplus.com/lgca2027/)
- 2027-06-25 ceremony: MJ Awards 2027 ceremony (source: https://awards.themj.co.uk/)

## Rules for agents

- Always cite the organiser's page; dates marked TBC or WATCH are not deadlines.
- Never submit a nomination on someone's behalf; the Hub drafts, people send.
- Contact is by the repository's contact form only.
